promise.title: Your pace, your risk, your call
promise.body: Blowhorn behaves exactly as you set it; nothing about the setting is ours. Every cap sits under Blowhorn's own ceiling for that platform, and above everything stands a hard cap from the limits the platform itself publishes. No stop, not even Weapons free, pushes past them and puts your accounts at risk. Your own caps can only lower them, never raise them.
